title: Highly recommended
text: We really  enjoyed the visit. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable with a very good level of English. We were very happy to have booked that visit. We would recommend it.
author: micheldN2834LU

title: Wonderful tour!
text: Our tour guide was Gosia. Her English was perfect and she was incredibly knowledgable about the cathedral. We loved how she explained the culture, religious, and social issues related to the cathedral. She also made sure my husband and I had enough opportunities to sit (resting from walking on the marble floor). The tour was tailor-made for us by Gosia. We loved the tour and Gosia.
author: Florence_C

title: A tour not to be missed
text: Our guide (Gosia?) was amazing and knowledgeable- an amazing  experience - we both learned so much. We now understand Granada more fully
author: Elizabeth_M

title: Excellent tour and guide
text:
Renata was on time waiting for us at hotel and started presentation as soon as we left it.
She is full of Granada knowledge and presents it in very professional way. She is also very flexible to meet her clients' needs.
author: Toly V

title: Private Tour with Gosia
text: We absolutely loved this tour. I wanted an in depth tour to learn more about the history of Granada and in particular Queen Isabella and King Ferdinand. Our guide Gosia was able to relate the information to us in a way that really brought everything to life. She is extremely knowledgeable and clearly passionate about Granada. We are very thankful and would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Granada.
author: AJ101511

title: Excellent
text: Gosia (we hope it is spelled correctly), was excellent, very interesting, very detailed, with excellent personality. I take time to answer questions and emphasized the right areas. From 1-5 (5 excellent), by consensus, we give you 5+.
author: Seaside03309748449

title: Fantastic.
text: Very good visit with a lot of history. Very friendly guide and with a lot of knowledge and easy to explain in a fun way.
